data.one_liner: A Dart bindings generator for Java and Kotlin APIs using JNI and dart:ffi.
data.what_it_does: JNIgen scans compiled JAR files or Java source files to generate Dart bindings. The generated Dart code communicates with C bindings that call Java functions via the Java Native Interface (JNI).
use_when: You need to call custom Java or Kotlin APIs from a Flutter or Dart application on Android or desktop platforms.
You want automated generation of type-safe Dart wrappers around Java classes and methods.
avoid_when: You are writing a pure Dart app without JVM dependencies.
You do not have a JDK installed or configured for your build environment.
strengths: Automates tedious FFI boilerplate for Java/Kotlin interop.
Supports Gradle and Android SDK dependencies out of the box.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration and a working JDK environment.
Class and symbol resolution can fail at runtime if ProGuard prunes classes on Android.
data.setup_notes: Requires a JDK (Java 17 to 21), CMake, and a C toolchain. For non-Android targets, manual JVM spawning via Jni.spawn is required.
